create_timing_with_tictoc: create a timing context by calling Tictoc() to get tic and toc functions for measuring elapsed time
run_tic_to_start_timer: run tic() to start an anonymous stack-based timer or tic(name) to start a named timer
run_toc_to_stop_timer: run toc() to stop the most recent anonymous timer or toc(name) to stop a named timer and return elapsed seconds
test_tictoc_named_timers: test the Tictoc factory by starting a named timer with tic('label') and stopping it with toc('label')
review_tictoc_stack_usage: review the Tictoc function to understand how anonymous timers use a stack for last-in-first-out timing
